summary: Using an Ottai M8 sensor: installing the Ottai app, starting the sensor, selecting the matching BG source in AAPS and turning on 'Share glucose data with AAPS' in the Ottai app.

sections.heading: Using M8 with Ottai app
sections.summary: Installing the Ottai app, selecting the Ottai/Syai source in Configuration > BG Source, and enabling data sharing with AAPS in the Ottai hub. The Ottai app labels are not AAPS strings.

manual_note: The page says to select Ottai as the BG source; the app has no source named Ottai. The source that receives Ottai data is listed as "Syai" (syai_tag_app, described as "Receive glucose data from Syai/Ottai App").
